name: Box0 Voice Link
description: BOX0 wireless mic bridge. The mic page streams continuously and records automatically: each session writes rec_<time>_{mic,sys,mix}.wav (mic track from the live audio stream, system track via WASAPI loopback, plus a mixed file). M cycles the on-screen hotkey (KEY_SEND 0/1/2 = start/enter/delete), RIGHT sends it, M hold = hold-to-talk (Left Alt+Left Win), LEFT sends Backspace.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: BOX0 无线麦联动。无线麦页面持续推流并自动录音：每次会话写出 rec_<时间>_{mic,sys,mix}.wav（麦克轨来自实时音频流、系统声音轨来自 WASAPI loopback、另有混合文件）。M 循环切换屏幕上的快捷键（KEY_SEND 0/1/2 = 语音开关/Enter/Backspace），右键发送，M 长按按住说话（左Alt+左Win），左键发送 Backspace。
